verdict.rationale: Oyster documents multi-country payroll and compliant EOR employment without the customer setting up local entities. Its hiring API uses per-country and per-subdivision rulesets for employment fields, which hints at state-level handling. No evidence explicitly covers running payroll across states within one country, per-state tax registrations, or state-specific withholding calculations. Missing for 10: explicit multi-state payroll support, per-state tax registration handling, per-state withholding documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
